description: Purpose of this region: decisions that have been taken, together with the reasoning behind them.
content:
This region records settled decisions so they do not have to be argued again.

Belongs here: what was decided, why, which alternatives were rejected and on what grounds, who decided, and when.

Does not belong here: an argument still in progress (scope.org_discussion), an idea nobody has ruled on (scope.org_suggestions), or the formal ballot itself (scope.org_voting).

The reasoning is the valuable part. A decision recorded without its "why" cannot be revisited sensibly when circumstances change.
